arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Feigin asserts tribes possess core inherent authority to investigate and detain suspects.
Henkel contends tribes lack sovereign authority over non-Indians and Congress holds plenary power.
Roberts questions the basis for treating executive power differently from legislative power.
Alito asks for a test to distinguish retained versus unretained aspects of tribal sovereignty.
